SESSION 3 STATE. Epic b5bc: 11 closed / 1 in_progress (7be3, code MERGED as Gerrit 1480, close queued) / 15 open. 13 Gerrit changes merged this run.

CLOSED: 176d 2d1c 2e16 723f 7504 8537 ae96 c9c6 d064 da31 e63c
OPEN:   0743 1de3 373f 3803 47e9 4b94 4fc1 8a31 8efe 9ce8 ab77 ad16 da4c f0ff fc0c

723f was force-closed on an explicit operator decision -- work merged (6d8ea3143a, c89a2ddcc4, both gates green) but the normal close path deadlocks. The deadlock is filed UNPARENTED as bug f680-4224-6553-48ca (talkable-ungodly-whapuku) with the verbatim gate messages.

47e9: plan PASSES (its AC1/AC6 contradiction was fixed -- a whole-file lock cannot also permit legitimate shrinkage; the corrected plan specifies a SEMANTIC lock). Claim blocked twice: first head-staleness (fixed by pinning to verified_at_sha), then stale-pin-drift on ae96 because the review pinned ae96 material that changed when ae96 was tagged and closed. A re-review after ae96 stabilised was running at session end.

WORKTREES READY (venv on py3.12 matching CI, resolving to own src): jw-47e9, jw-3803, jw-1de3.
IMPORTANT: provision with 'make venv && make install', NOT bare python3 -m venv -- make venv pins the interpreter to .github/python-version.txt (3.12); a bare venv inherits host python3 (3.14) and can hide a version-specific failure.

CONCURRENCY: another agent is working this same store (review-plan seen running against 65d7 and ccf6-a065-b1d6-4cf1). That is the source of the write-lock contention and the fast-moving origin/main that stales attestations mid-review. Not self-inflicted; plan for it.

ORDER OF OPERATIONS THAT AVOIDS THE GATE THRASH:
  1. tick AC boxes and add any [operator-attested] tags FIRST
  2. then review-plan
  3. then claim IMMEDIATELY (same shell invocation)
  4. if claim reports head-staleness, pin: git checkout --detach <verified_at_sha> then claim
  5. if claim reports stale-pin-drift, the named dependency changed after the review -- wait for
     that dependency to stabilise (ideally close) and re-review
